headline: Gutter Rekindles as Flag Fighting Rages from Expanse to Berm
war_summary: Gutter, all but cold at our last filing, has roared back into flame: ten flags changed hands in the two hours before this edition, the last logged at the very minute of writing, Kuoppa and Lost Kaivo the busiest posts. Weathered Expanse remains the war's busiest ground — seven more transfers, twenty-six on the day, four of its nine strongpoints now no-man's-land — though the butcher's bill there cooled sharply, from over eleven hundred in two hours to about one hundred sixty. Palantine Berm still simmers, three flags moved since our last lines, Vendett again the storm-centre. Marban Hollow and Stlican Shelf each logged fresh movement within the past three hours after quieter spells. The Nevish Line's flags have rested since 03:22, but its guns have not: two hundred seventy-six casualties fell there in two hours. Callahans Passage, transferless still, bleeds fastest of all — over seven hundred in the past hour. Godcrofts, silent near twenty hours on flags, abruptly showed blood and fresh enlistments in the last hour. The war stands in its 640th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
